arrival.text: What's that? It has an antenna… Someone built this.
I'll use the scanner to find out where it came from.

scan.text: I'm Pioneer 10. I left Earth in 1972 to explore Jupiter.
I was the first spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt and visit that planet up close. I sent pictures and information to the people following my journey back home.
Then I kept going. My mission didn't include a trip back.
Over time, I had less and less power. My last signal reached Earth in 2003.
I carry a plaque with drawings of humans and clues to where they came from. A message for anyone who might find me one day.

wrap_up.text: I'll keep a copy of that plaque here in my ship.

reward_lines.text: Maybe there are others nearby. I'll check the radar.

reaction.text: A message for whoever found it… I think that means me.
